name: Adaptive Voxel Hashing Refined by Depth Residual
aliases: Adaptive resolution built from existing infrastructure
definition: A tier API that fuses into a stack of ordinary VoxelBlockGrids at halving voxel sizes (default 2 cm, 1 cm, 5 mm). It gives a block finer voxels only where the depth is systematically off the coarser level's surface, replacing the retired octree trial.
summary: Adaptive Voxel Hashing Refined by Depth Residual is a hierarchical volume representation that uses depth residuals to dynamically refine voxel grids only where systematic deviations occur, reducing memory usage compared to uniform grids.
